name: Kaieda Hazumi
source:
Specialities: philosophy and comparative religion
Weakness: sports in general
Hobby: housework in general. She especially loves cooking and knitting

Language teacher at Kanna Academy. She is Kouji's cousin who takes care of cooking and housework at Kaieda household. In the Kaieda household that houses those who are both decadent and artistically inclined, she is the sole person stubborn enough to secure a position as a teacher. She shows neither talent nor interest in art, instead possessing fascination towards the metaphysical world that can't be drawn. She is extremely gentle and always gives a heartwarming impression to those around her. However, she tends to make false assumptions upon which she can't easily be swayed to change her mind.

[Translated from [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item41352]Gyutto product page[/url]]
